correctness.rationale: Nine given projective points are the B3 root directions. The nine independent evaluation conditions on 15 quartic monomials give dim I(Z)_4=6. An independent SymPy calculation verified rank 9, that all six displayed A/B quartics vanish and form a basis, and evaluated all 48 signed permutation lifts, 24 projective transformations, preserving each 3-dimensional span. Trace-pair frequency among 24 group elements is (3,3):1, (-1,1):6, (1,-1):6, (-1,-1):3, (0,0):8; this agrees with irreducible S4 standard and sign-twisted standard characters and total (6,0,-2,0,0). Incidence of four three-rich lines yields injection into S4, proving signed subgroup is full stabilizer. No one- or two-dimensional invariant subspace or invariant quartic follows by irreducibility.

evidence: Primary papers cover the full projective equivalence class and dim6, but do not supply the complete character of the stabilizer action on I(Z)_4.

originality.rationale: Bauer–Malara–Szemberg–Szpond’s arXiv:1804.03610 explicitly gives nine B3 points and 6-dimensional quartic system, with quartic formula Eq(4) supplying basis monomials. Farnik–Galuppi–Sodomaco–Trok arXiv:1804.03590 proves uniqueness up to projectivity. Thus the configuration, basis and existence are prior-covered. The submitted new claim is the precise full projective-stabilizer representation, its character and irreducible decomposition, which neither inspected primary text states. Resultary search returned a distinct B3 marked-point discriminant result but not equivalent S4 module. Residual risk: classical reflection-arrangement representation literature could encode the same module.

value.rationale: Determining the complete symmetry module of a natural six-dimensional interpolation space supporting the unique unexpected quartic is a motivated exact structural invariant. It identifies zero fixed quartics and no invariant lines/planes, thereby distinguishing how symmetries act on the ambient quartic system, rather than simply repeating the well-known unexpected curve.

limitations: Only the quartic interpolation space over C for the nine-point configuration, not individual marked-point quartics or higher degrees.
An unindexed classical type-B3 reflection-arrangement representation calculation could contain the same character under different terminology.
No classification of stabilizer representations for other unexpected curves or fixed general marked triple-point quartics.
